entries.043e00913431f5c4: It is a business model that concentrates schools in Kanagawa Prefecture, provides lessons to elementary, junior high and high school students and after-school childcare, and earns income such as tuition fees.
entries.052bef8e59fb5d38: With "a cram school that energizes children" as its concept, its basic management policies include devoting itself exclusively to the cram school business and intensively investing management resources in its specialized field, developing schools concentrated in Kanagawa Prefecture, and constantly pursuing higher quality in lesson content and systems. As its medium- to long-term approach, it states that it aims to grow while maintaining the quality of lessons and operations by alternately repeating, every few years, periods in which it focuses on opening new schools and periods in which it focuses on internal enhancement. It states that in the fiscal year ending September 2026, it will operate as a period in which it takes a restrained approach to opening new schools and focuses on adding classes at full schools and improving the seat occupancy rate. In the medium term, it lists as an issue forming a school network in Kawasaki City and in areas of Yokohama City where it has not yet expanded, such as Tsurumi Ward, Naka Ward, Minami Ward and Kanazawa Ward.

entries.5b570b9b8d40f701: It is a regionally concentrated cram school specializing in the cram school business, operating 167 schools only in Kanagawa Prefecture. The number of students was 36,744 as of the end of September 2025, and the average during the period was 35,126, exceeding 35,000 for the first time. It has both an elementary and junior high school student division and a high school student division, and consistently handles after-school childcare as well.
entries.5cbb5f00c1343378: Net sales for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥15,846 million, up 5.0% from the previous fiscal year. The elementary and junior high school student division was ¥12,520 million and the high school student division was ¥3,326 million.
entries.62b66e8d65f59127: In the public high school entrance examinations in spring 2025, 1,367 students passed at 8 schools in Kanagawa Prefecture designated as academic improvement advancement focus schools, and it ranked 1st in the number of successful students by cram school at 7 of those schools. In university entrance examinations as well, the number of current students passing national and public universities as a whole reached 410, renewing its record high. Its track record of teaching, centered on public high school students in Kanagawa Prefecture, supports evaluations of its entrance examination guidance.
